algorithmic_scope: Pareto bilateral mask/extension dominance with temporal persistence; safe handoff endpoint contextual corroboration

dominance_margin_ratio.justification: competitor must be worse for EACH wrist in BOTH finite-mask distance and real-mask extension; bp_518/bp_520 show much larger margins but no identity ground truth on all frames

winner_max_mask_distance_ratio.justification: require candidate mask geometrically reachable by both wrists; does not replace bilateral signed-q/axis quality

dominance_min_consecutive_frames.justification: reuse documented minimum multiframe support; no single-frame promotions

handoff_context_min_observations.justification: compatible handoff alone is insufficient; require independent mask-quality support on both sides

no_change: All original Pose thresholds, V3 parameters, split criteria, and source files remain unchanged.
